title: Leads

intake.title: Lead Intake — Review
intake.subtitle: Every new lead from Meta lands here for review. Release the ones you want onto the sales board, or discard. Possible duplicates are flagged.
intake.confirm_discard: Discard this lead? It will not appear on the sales board.
intake.import_done: Imported {{imported}} leads ({{flagged}} flagged as possible duplicates).
intake.import_empty: No leads found in the file.
intake.import_parse_error: Could not read the file. Use a CSV or Excel (.xlsx) file.
intake.merge_disabled: No matching existing lead — only Release/Discard available
intake.bulk_confirm: Merge {{count}} duplicates into their existing leads? {{dead}} duplicates of dead-end / not-interested leads will also be removed.
intake.merge_removed_dead_end: The existing lead is dead-end / not interested — the new lead was removed instead of merged.
intake.bulk_release_confirm: Release {{count}} clean (non-duplicate) leads onto the sales board?
intake.release_confirm_dup: This lead matches {{count}} existing record(s). Releasing it will create a NEW lead on the sales board anyway. Continue?
intake.release_reflagged: This lead now matches existing records and was not released — review the duplicate flags, then Release again to override.
intake.merge_dead_end_confirm: That lead is marked dead-end / not interested. Merging into it will DISCARD this new submission instead of keeping it. Continue?
intake.reengage_confirm: Re-engage {{name}} — move to Unique Lead and append this submission?
